payload.core_mechanism_summary: Prime factorize b, apply Legendre's formula to count prime factors in n!, then compute min over primes of floor(exponent_n! / exponent_b).
payload.rationale: Solution performs an exhaustive check over prime factors of b to find the limiting factor, which loosely fits branch-and-bound paradigm of eliminating possibilities, but actual algorithm is number-theoretic, not a search.
